nodes.summary: Exactly two permutations $\tau \in S_3$ have exactly one descent and major index $1$, that is, $\operatorname{des}(\tau) = 1$ and $\operatorname{maj}(\tau) = 1$; equivalently, their descent set is $\{1\}$.
nodes.title: Permutations of $S_3$ with descent set $\{1\}$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $d_1, \dots, d_M$ (the numbers of folds of the $M$ diamonds) and a natural number $k$, the position of the $k$th link, counting positions from $0$, is $L_k = \sum_{m=1}^{\min(k, M)} (d_m + 1)$. In particular $L_0 = 0$, and $L_k = d_1 + \dots + d_M + M$ for every $k \ge M$.
nodes.title: Position of the $k$th link of a multifold partition diamond

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $d_1, \dots, d_M$, the set of link positions is $\{L_0, L_1, \dots, L_M\}$, where $L_k = \sum_{m=1}^{k} (d_m + 1)$ is the position of the $k$th link. These positions satisfy $0 = L_0 < L_1 < \dots < L_M = c - 1$, where $c = d_1 + \dots + d_M + M + 1$ is the number of parts.
nodes.title: The set of link positions of a multifold partition diamond

nodes.summary: Let $c = d_1 + \dots + d_M + M + 1$ be the number of parts of the multifold partition diamond whose diamonds have $d_1, \dots, d_M$ folds, and let $n$ be a natural number. A vector $(a_0, \dots, a_{c-1})$ with entries in $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ is read as the function $\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ that sends $p$ to $a_p$ for $p < c$ and to $0$ for $p \ge c$.
nodes.title: Extending a part vector by zero

nodes.summary: The multifold partition diamond whose $M$ diamonds have $d_1, \dots, d_M$ folds has $c = d_1 + \dots + d_M + M + 1$ parts.
nodes.title: Number of parts of a multifold partition diamond

nodes.summary: For every commutative ring $R$ and all $x, y \in R$, the Euler–Mahonian polynomial $E_1$ satisfies $E_1(x, y) = 1$.
nodes.title: The first Euler–Mahonian polynomial is $1$

nodes.summary: Over the integers, the Euler–Mahonian polynomial $E_3$ takes the value $E_3(2, 3) = 157$.
nodes.title: Euler–Mahonian polynomial $E_3$ at $(2, 3)$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$ and elements $x, y$ of a commutative ring, the Euler–Mahonian polynomial evaluated at $(x, y)$ is $E_d(x, y) = \sum_{\tau \in S_d} x^{\operatorname{des}(\tau)} y^{\operatorname{maj}(\tau)}$, where $\operatorname{des}(\tau)$ is the number of descents and $\operatorname{maj}(\tau)$ the major index of the permutation $\tau$.
nodes.title: Euler–Mahonian polynomial

A function $b : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ is a multifold partition diamond with fold sum $i$ and link sum $j$ when the following hold: for every $k$ with $0 \le k < M$ and every $f$ with $1 \le f \le d_{k+1}$, we have…
nodes.title: Multifold partition diamonds with given fold and link sums

nodes.summary: There is exactly one multifold partition diamond of shape $(1)$ with fold sum $1$ and link sum $1$. Equivalently, there is exactly one triple of nonnegative integers $b_0 \le b_1 \le b_2$ with $b_1 = 1$ and $b_0 + b_2 = 1$.
nodes.title: Single-fold diamonds with fold sum 1 and link sum 1

nodes.summary: There are exactly two multifold partition diamonds of shape $(2)$ with fold sum $1$ and link sum $2$. Equivalently, there are exactly two quadruples $(b_0, b_1, b_2, b_3)$ of nonnegative integers with $b_0 \le b_f \le b_3$ for $f = 1, 2$, $b_1 + b_2 = 1$ and $b_0 + b_3 = 2$.
nodes.title: Two-fold diamonds with fold sum 1 and link sum 2

A multifold partition diamond of shape $(d_1, \dots, d_M)$ is a sequence $(b_0, \dots, b_{c-1})$ of nonnegative integers such that $b_{L_{k-1}} \le b_{L_{k-1} + f} \le b_{L_k}$ for all $1 \le k \le M$ and $1 \le f \le d_k$. nodes.title: Product formula for equal-fold partition diamonds

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\tau$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, d - 1\}$, the number of descents $\mathrm{des}(\tau) = |\mathrm{Des}(\tau)|$ is the number of elements of the descent set $\mathrm{Des}(\tau)$.
nodes.title: Number of descents from the descent set

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\tau$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, d - 1\}$, the descent set is $\mathrm{Des}(\tau) = \{p \in \{1, \dots, d - 1\} : \tau(p - 1) > \tau(p)\}$. If $\tau$ is read as the permutation $p \mapsto \tau(p - 1) + 1$ of $\{1, \dots, d\}$, this is the usual descent set: the positions $p$, numbered from $1$, where the value at $p$ exceeds the value at $p + 1$.
nodes.title: Descent set of a permutation

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\tau$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, d - 1\}$, the major index is $\mathrm{maj}(\tau) = \sum_{p \in \mathrm{Des}(\tau)} p$, the sum of the positions, numbered from $1$, in the descent set $\mathrm{Des}(\tau)$.
nodes.title: Major index of a permutation

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\tau$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, d - 1\}$ and a natural number $j$, this is the natural number $\tau(j)$ when $j < d$, and $0$ when $j \ge d$. It is used to read off descents.
nodes.title: Value of a permutation at a natural position

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
